info.name: Splitit Account Management System Authentication Merchant Management API

description.content:
API for onboarding and managing sub-merchants on the Splitit platform. Enables payment facilitators and marketplace operators to add merchant partners, upload compliance documents, send onboarding invitations, monitor approval status, retrieve pending accounts, and generate time-limited secure login links for merchant portal access.
